digest.component_or_area: review_bot app lifespan / reconciler shutdown drain
propositions: The shutdown drain waits only on webhook queue.join(), so reconcile_loop tasks are cancelled within ~10s even if a reconciler review is minutes in-flight.
A reconciler review awaits review_and_vote inline (outside the queue), so when the queue is empty the join returns immediately and the reconcile task is abandoned without draining.
Any manual container stop (docker compose restart, host reboot, systemd stop, autodeploy rollback) kills a reconciler review with effectively no drain, leaving it silent (no VOTER_ERROR emitted).
The shutdown drain must coordinate with reconcile to prevent new reviews starting while draining, or the drain budget can be extended indefinitely.
Both webhook queue and reconciler review drains must share a single shutdown_drain_seconds() deadline to respect the existing stop_grace_period relationship.
